solution:
\(\text{v}_{\min} = \sqrt{rg\left(\frac{\tan\theta - \mu_s}{1 + \mu_s \tan\theta}\right)}\)

\(= \sqrt{9.9 \times 10 \left(\frac{0.5 - 0.2}{1 + (0.2 \times 0.5)}\right)} = \sqrt{27} = 5.196\ \text{m/s}\)

Allowed \(\text{v}_{\min}\) should be 10% higher than this.

\(\therefore (\text{v}_{\min})_{\text{allowed}} = 5.196 \times \frac{110}{100} = 5.716\ \frac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}\)

\(\text{v}_{\max} = \sqrt{rg\left(\frac{\tan\theta + \mu_s}{1 - \mu_s \tan\theta}\right)}\)

\(= \sqrt{9.9 \times 10 \left(\frac{0.5 + 0.2}{1 - (0.2 \times 0.5)}\right)} = \sqrt{77} = 8.775\ \text{m/s}\)

Allowed \(\text{v}_{\max}\) should be 10% lower than this.

\(\therefore (\text{v}_{\max})_{\text{allowed}} = 8.775 \times \frac{90}{100} = 7.898\ \text{m/s}\)
note: 8.775 x 0.9 = 7.8975, printed 7.896; HSC Rotational Dynamics speed limits.
